During the [[Galactic War]], [[Theron Shan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] '''infiltrated''' the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Ascendant Spear]]'' in order to the sabotage it and allow the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to destroy it as part of an [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|ambush]] at [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="Annihilation" />
